desc: Balance the sheer power of tungsten with the patterning and practicality of steel to deliver better lethality on ducks and geese. HEVI-Shot HEVI-Hitter devotes 20 percent of its payload to 12 g/cc tungsten and layers it over 80 percent steel shot. This carefully engineered blend brings out the best in both materials, offering a large, effective pattern at close and moderate targets, as well as the pellet count, power and density needed to drop distant birds.
